Order Custom Jewelry Widget

Get a ready‑to‑use jewelry calculator for your site. No account, no setup fee, just a simple embed that shows your customers how much a piece is worth.

How it works for a jewelry retailer

  1. Visit the Order Custom Jewelry Widget page.
  2. Choose the calculator type (diamond, gold, ring size, etc.).
  3. Copy the single line of code.
  4. Paste it into your website’s HTML where you want the widget to appear.
  5. Your visitors can now instantly see values, sizes, or prices without leaving your site.

What you get / what it costs

  • Free widgets with a “Powered by CaratBase” line.
  • Pro widgets (no attribution, custom call‑to‑action button, inquiries go straight to you) at $12/month per domain.
  • No hidden fees.
  • No need for a user account or special software.

FAQ

Question? *Can I use the widget on any website?* Yes. The code works on any HTML‑based site.

Question? *Do I need to pay for each visitor?* No. The cost is a flat monthly fee; each visitor is free.

Question? *What happens if I want a custom look?* The Pro widget lets you add a custom call‑to‑action button and removes the attribution line.

Ready to give your customers instant value? Order your custom jewelry widget now
